exposure: HRT cycles with pretreatment using GnRHa (HRT + GnRHa)
cohort: 5316 women who had singleton deliveries undergoing FET cycles between 2016 and 2020
finding: Singletons from HRT were related to higher risks of HDP and cesarean section compared to NC, particularly for young women, while GnRHa pretreatment did not improve perinatal outcomes compared with HRT cycles alone.
birth_weight: newborn birth weight was not significantly different between the three groups
